description_en: Checks whether the certificate and private key uploaded for a specified domain name configuration match
description_zh: 检查指定域名配置上传的证书和私钥信息是否匹配
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-cert-match-status --domain www.example.com --certificate example-string --biz-private-key example-string --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCertMatchStatus

parameters.help_en: The domain name that is added to WAF
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The content of the certificate file
parameters.name: certificate

parameters.example: -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----- DADTPZoOHd9WtZ3UKHJTRgNQ****Qn2bqdKHop+B/dn/4VZL7Jt8zSDGM9sTMThLyvsmLQKBgQCr+ujntC1kN6pGBj2Fw2l/EA/W3rYEce2tyhjgmG7rZ+A/jVE9fld5sQra6ZdwBcQJaiygoIYoaMF2EjRwc0qwHaluq0C15f6ujSoHh2e+D5zdmkTg/3NKNjqNv6xA2gYpinVDzFdZ9Zujxvuh9o4Vqf0YF8bv5UK5G04RtKadOw== -----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
parameters.help_en: The content of the private key file
parameters.name: private_key

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

MatchStatus.description_en: Indicates whether the certificate and private key match
MatchStatus.description_zh: 证书与私钥内容是否匹配
